query: 结社自由与集体谈判 结社自由与集体谈判 衡量企业保障员工自愿组建、加入工会等组织，并以此与雇主进行有关薪酬、福利、工作条件等事项集体协商权利的程度。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：发布了明确的结社自由声明，包含“禁止打压/歧视工会代表”的专项条款；具备完善的集体谈判争议处理流程；披露了具体的集体合同关键条款及审议机制。 • 1分（合格）：有基础的政策承诺，具备工会或职工代表大会（职代会）组织，但缺乏深度的禁止打压机制说明或具体的集体协商争议解决程序。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关政策披露，或仅有笼统的“重视沟通”表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：相关政策及集体合同覆盖 >80% 的员工或经营地区。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅在国内主体执行而未覆盖海外子公司，或未说明具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 结社自由 集体谈判 工会 集体合同 职工代表大会 劳资协商 禁止打压工会代表 集体协商 freedom of association collective bargaining trade union collective agreement works council labour-management negotiation non-retaliation against union representatives 是否发布结社自由或集体谈判政策声明？ 是否包含禁止打压/歧视工会代表的条款？ 是否存在工会、职代会或集体合同机制？ 集体谈判争议如何处理？ 政策或集体合同覆盖多少员工或地区？

results.section: 7. PROPELLING THE COMPANY BY TALENTS AND GROWING WITH EMPLOYEES
results.text: Based on the business needs of the Company, the Group formulates its recruitment plans in accordance with the development needs of the Company and unified arrangements to attract talents. We resolutely implement the Provisions on Prohibition of Child Labor ( 《禁止使用童工規 定》 ), strictly verify the identification documents, academic degree materials and other information of prospective recruits to confirm whether they reach the legal employment age and eliminate the employment of child labor. Those who fail to comply with our employment provisions will not be employed. Up to the end of the Reporting Period, the Group had no incident of child labor.

[Content]
Based on the business needs of the Company, the Group formulates its recruitment plans in accordance with the development needs of the Company and unified arrangements to attract talents. We resolutely implement the Provisions on Prohibition of Child Labor ( 《禁止使用童工規 定》 ), strictly verify the identification documents, academic degree materials and other information of prospective recruits to confirm whether they reach the legal employment age and eliminate the employment of child labor. Those who fail to comply with our employment provisions will not be employed. Up to the end of the Reporting Period, the Group had no incident of child labor.
